authorisation_record.why_recorded_this_way: Annex B assigns the governance signature to the project decision owner. The external QA operator does not hold that authority and has not signed on the owner's behalf. This record preserves the authorisation and its provenance so the owner can either countersign it or replace it with a formally signed block.
authorisation_record.hash_binding_note: Annex B requires the owner to sign the date and the ARCHIVE hash. An archive hash cannot be stored inside the archive it describes, so the in-package binding is the manifest digest, which covers every other file. The archive digest is reported alongside the delivered archive and must be entered by the owner when countersigning.
